## TotemAutomata 0.1.18

- Adds a module-owned, read-only Observer reconstruction for the Copper Golem menu.
- Uses the production screen rendering path while blocking observer-side input and packets.
- Relays bounded semantic state and remote cursor data without screenshots, pixels, or framebuffer capture.
- Requires TotemCore 0.7.12 or newer within the 0.7.x compatibility line.

Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25
